items.where: whole canal front: square-ish dark-framed windows 1.7 x 2.3 m (a mullion and a transom) on a 2.41 m pitch, a pale shutter-box strip over each head; five rows on the tall north-west block, four plus the set-back top storey on the lower south-east part, short high windows (2.0-3.6 m) in the ground storey
items.how: 0.15 m cuts with dark reveals, mullion and transom bars 7 cm proud of the glass, a proud pale head strip; columns carried onto the set-back storey walls in the same t frame

items.where: first storey of the north-west block, t 2.3-18.1 m: a band storey projecting over the quay, white bands top and bottom (5.0-5.2 and 7.6-7.8 m), six larger windows on a 2.51 m pitch
items.how: box 0.6 m proud: holed front, side returns, white band bars whose undersides form the soffit

items.where: north-west corner, t 0.3-2.3 m: a thin white canopy at 7.0 m over the corner entrance
t 17.3-20.8 m between the two parts: upper storeys recessed about 2 m above a terrace at 12.2 m with a white slab edge and windows in the recessed wall
items.how: 3DBAG tiers (12.2 m roof) with the window grid on the recessed walls and a white slab edge

items.where: south-east part: front parapet at 15.7 m, the top storey set back about 2.2 m, its window heads showing over the parapet
items.how: 3DBAG tiers 15.67/19.85 m; the set-back wall carries the grid

items.where: ground storey t 27.2-41.0 m: three wide dark vehicle openings with white lintels at 3.6 m
items.how: 0.4 m deep dark cuts with proud white lintel bars

items.where: t 40.2-43.5 m: a pale grey panelled shaft rising from the first-storey canopy to about 17.5 m, above the front parapet
items.how: proud stone box with three dark vertical joints; panel pattern not drawn

items.where: t 38.5-45.5 m: a white canopy band at 4.8-5.7 m over the south-east ground storey
Harry Karssen plastiek, metres high on the facade (nl.wikipedia Lijnbaansgracht 219)

skip.note: removed around 2017 (nl.wikipedia Harry Karssen); no sculpture on the 2021 or 2022 panoramas

items.where: small red plaque and a post sign by the north-west entrance

skip.note: 0.6 x 0.25 m plaque; the round sign stands on a street post, not the building

items.where: north-west end over the bridge: three columns of the same dark-framed windows per storey (centres 1.7, 3.9, 6.1 m), brown brick like the front
items.how: same window cut as the front, three columns

items.where: white horizontal rails across a recessed first storey (2022 view)
items.how: the bay band storey returns on this end as white band bars; the rail bars are not separate

This back wall stands behind those houses; drawn in the front's brown brick with its dark-framed window grid.
